description: Every annotation on the takeoff, with condition_id RESOLVED to its finish tag so you can act on the reply without joining against conditions[]. Filter by sheet, by condition, or both. Coordinates come back in image px (the same frame you passed in), not the normalized form they're stored as. `unattached` counts the notes carrying no condition — the candidates for link_annotation. `verdicts` is the approval family's inventory (mark_verdict/delete_verdict): every mark with its actor stated — the estimator's APPROVED ring or the agent's AGENT diamond — under the same filters, a condition filter reaching a verdict through its target shape. Coordinates are image px at render scale 2.0: PDF pt × 2, origin top-left, y down (the browser canvas's native space). Sheet payloads carry dims in both px and pt.

condition.description: Only annotations attached to this finish tag

name: list_annotations

condition.description: Resolved finish tag, or '' when unattached — saves joining against conditions[]

length_lf.description: Dimension only: the measured length in real feet, snapshotted at annotate time from the sheet scale

unattached.description: How many carry no condition — candidates for link_annotation

verdicts.description: Approval-family records (#176) under the same filters: sheet applies directly; a condition filter reaches a verdict THROUGH its target shape (a sheet-point mark carries no scope and drops out)

actor.description: "estimator" = the human APPROVED ring (ink — import-borne here, never minted over MCP), "agent" = the AGENT diamond

at.description: Render anchor (image px) — absent only when the record rides a sheet from a file this session hasn't loaded (#152)

condition.description: The targeted shape's finish tag, resolved — '' for sheet-point marks

shape_id.description: Present when the verdict targets a committed shape — WHAT was marked, not where it draws

text.description: The optional short note riding the record
